title: Identification of WDR74 and TNFRSF12A as biomarkers for early osteoarthritis using machine learning and immunohistochemistry.
summary: XGBoost-selected WDR74 and TNFRSF12A differentiated osteoarthritis samples, with qPCR and human knee-tissue immunohistochemistry confirmation.
ai_technology: Single-cell and co-expression analyses feed XGBoost marker selection; the source reports diagnostic AUCs above 0.9 and laboratory/tissue checks.
organization: Department of Orthopedics; Institute of Microsurgery on Extremities

evidence.tested: Human tissue IHC and in-vitro qPCR support expression differences; no prospective screening benefit is claimed.
evidence.unknown: Primary Results describe the specific comparator, cohort or experimental check; limitations are stated narrowly.
